name: Bi-Lateral Ginnie Mae Financing Agreement
broughtBy: Jamie Cowan, Special Advisor to Joseph Gormley, Ginnie Mae
summary: A standardized template and common language for the bilateral financing agreements made between Ginnie Mae Issuers and their financiers, which Ginnie Mae supplements with its Acknowledgment Agreement.
whyRaised: Ginnie Mae seeks to establish a MISMO-sponsored working group to obtain input from Issuers and lenders on standardizing bilateral financing agreements associated with the Acknowledgment Agreement (AA) program. While Ginnie Mae's AA program has facilitated greater liquidity for Ginnie Mae Issuers, we are aware that the approval process for these agreements can be time consuming and costly. Standardization of the financing agreement documents between Issuer and lender is the most likely mechanism for increasing efficiency in the approval process. We are seeking to obtain industry input on how to best standardize the bilateral financing agreement template and language to reduce legal cost barriers, expedite internal approval timelines, and improve participation in the AA program.
potentialSolutions: A standardized bilateral financing agreement template
Standardized agreement language between Issuer and financier
Reduced legal cost barriers to entering the AA program
Shorter internal approval timelines for Issuers and financiers
Broader participation in the Acknowledgment Agreement program
